Name: Mountain Gardens (PIF)
Author: Sharogg
Description:
This adds a mountain garden to your farmhouse with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]PIF - Personal Rooms[/url]. It works like the backyard, meaning you can grow crops, plant trees, keep animals and decorate. It features a spectacular backdrop and cliff terrain of different heights. New areas become accessible with each farmhouse upgrade.

You need to buy one of the doors from PIF or a decorational door to access it.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Grass tiles tillable
[*]Buildable location
[*]Mountain fish
[*]no weeds or dirt decay
[*]some berry bushes
[*]hang the painting of the season on the cliffs
[*]Panorama view
[/list][b]
Compatibility[/b]
Should be compatible with everything.

[b]Credits[/b]
Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24690]Aimon's Small Hilltop Farm[/url]

[b]Mods used in screenshots[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15079]Better Water 2[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20972]Simple Foliage[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6742]Flowergrass and Snowfields[/url]

[b]Installation[/b]
Unzip the mod and paste it into Stardew Valley's Mods folder. Requires SMAPI,
Content Patcher and PIF. 1.6. is required.
